svg.title: AWS EKS microservices platform architecture
svg.desc: A 3D style architecture diagram for Bawantha Rathnayake’s personal EKS project. Browsers reach CloudFront and an application load balancer, with Route 53 for DNS. EKS ingress routes to frontend and API gateway services. The gateway connects authentication and issue services using RDS MySQL. GitHub Actions builds images for ECR and updates manifests in Git. Argo CD reads Git and syncs application configuration. Terraform provisions AWS infrastructure. External Secrets Operator syncs Secrets Manager values into Kubernetes secrets. Prometheus and Grafana provide monitoring.
